stem: If \(15 - \frac{x}{2} \ge 6\), what is the greatest possible value of \(x\)?
solution: Multiply both sides by \(-2\) and reverse the sign: \(x \le 18\).
The greatest possible value of \(x\) is 18. Check: \(15 - 9 = 6\).
verify:
x = symbols('x')
s = solve_univariate_inequality(15 - x/2 >= 6, x, relational=False)
assert s == Interval(-oo, 18)
assert [Rational(a) for a in spr_answers] == [s.sup]
